latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the gemini skill for one-shot Q&A, summarization, and text generation via SkillBoss API Hub.
- Supports Python and curl quick starts using the /v1/pilot endpoint, which automatically selects the optimal LLM.
- Offers configurable model preferences: balanced, quality, or price.
- Requires only setting the SKILLBOSS_API_KEY environment variable; no CLI installation needed.
